authority: Line owner 2026-10-16 production-line optimisation plan §4: see a scene's timing before anything is paid for.
activation_note: Enabled from E12 onwards (2026-10-17) after offline validation.  Earlier episodes keep the locked behaviour; E12+ may opt out via previs_policy=null in the contract.

rules.zero_credit_previs: Built only from artefacts the line already has — generation contract, grouping plan, existing keyframes, existing dialogue audio.  Never calls an image, video, voice or VLM provider.
rules.machine_checks_block: Objective contract conflicts (dialogue coverage, shot coverage, speaker registration, unit order) block before any POST.
rules.director_review_advisory: Subjective questions (scene readable, redundant shots, reactions, cuts, combat, static dialogue) are advisory after max_rounds; they never auto-regenerate.
